title.en: 4108 on Diesel 40 Is Not the Diesel Mixer Order
title.zh: 柴油40上的 4108 不是柴油搅拌泵订单

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 4108 on Diesel 40 at 66 kW and on the diesel mixer at 66–75 kW. Diesel 40 is pump-only at 26 m³/h. The mixer is 25 m³/h with three stone rows.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 4108 印在柴油40上为 66 kW，印在柴油搅拌泵上为 66–75 kW。柴油40是只泵送的 26 m³/h。搅拌泵是 25 m³/h 并有三行石子。

h1.en: Say Whether the 4108 Order Includes a Mixer
h1.zh: 写明这张 4108 订单是否包含搅拌

directAnswer.en: A buyer who writes only “4108” has not ordered a machine from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 120 m / 360 m, Kawasaki 112, 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm and 2800 kg. The diesel mixer prints 4108 / 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, three stone-distance rows, 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm and 4200 kg. The mixer path is the one that mixes and pumps. Diesel 40 does not list a mixer motor. Send one path to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
directAnswer.zh: 只写“4108”并没有向河北品锦机械（邢台）订下一台机器。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、120 m / 360 m、川崎 112、4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm、2800 kg。柴油搅拌泵印 4108 / 66–75 kW、25 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、三行石子距离、4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm、4200 kg。又搅拌又泵送的是搅拌泵路径。柴油40不列搅拌电机。把一条路径发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

heading.en: Kilowatts are not the same string

body.en: 66 kW on Diesel 40 is a single printed power. 66–75 kW on the mixer is a range. Keep the range if you order the mixer.
body.zh: 柴油40上的 66 kW 是一个印出的功率。搅拌泵上的 66–75 kW 是区间。订搅拌泵时保留区间。

body.en: 3000 mm is printed on the diesel mixer. Diesel 40’s height is 1800 mm. A transport note that swaps them is the wrong crate.
body.zh: 柴油搅拌泵印了 3000 mm。柴油40的高度是 1800 mm。运输说明如果对调，箱子就错了。

body.en: Diesel 40’s description ties 120 m / 360 m to 1 cm aggregate. The mixer prints ≤ 1 inch, 13 mm and 24 mm as separate rows.
body.zh: 柴油40的说明把 120 m / 360 m 与 1 cm 骨料写在一起。搅拌泵把 ≤ 1 英寸、13 mm 和 24 mm 分成不同的行。

answer.en: The diesel mixer. Diesel 40 is 2800 kg.
answer.zh: 柴油搅拌泵。柴油40是 2800 kg。

question.en: Is the mixer a batching plant?

answer.en: No price is printed for either page.

alt.en: Diesel mixer pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery, a Xingtai concrete pump manufacturer
alt.zh: 柴油搅拌泵，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
